name: CoChalet Brand Voice Guard
description: V10 brand voice guardrails for all Gemini Studio content generation. Enforces canon terminology, bans confusing or off-brand language, and ensures messaging parity across personas.

bannedWordNotes.fractional ownership: Banned in public-facing content. Use 'deeded co-ownership' or 'alpine co-ownership' instead.
bannedWordNotes.fractional: Banned as standalone in public content. Acceptable only in internal/investor docs with full context.
bannedWordNotes.time-share: Hyphenated variant also banned. CoChalet is deeded co-ownership, not a timeshare.
bannedWordNotes.timeshare: CoChalet is deeded co-ownership, not a timeshare.

toneGuidelines.general: Warm, confident, grounded. Never salesy or breathless.
toneGuidelines.DW: Empathetic, productivity-aware. Name the pain (CUT), show the relief (soulagement).
toneGuidelines.PC: Aspirational but real. Show the dream (Montrer le reve), anchor in belonging (appartenance).
toneGuidelines.investor: Data-driven, transparent. Canon numbers only. No hype language.

rules.rule: Never use 'fractional ownership' or 'fractional' as standalone in public-facing content
Never use 'timeshare' or 'time-share' in any context
Use canon financial numbers only — no rounding or approximation
